name: GlobalSign Atlas AnyCA REST Gateway Plugin
description: GlobalSign Atlas plugin for the AnyCA REST Gateway framework

ca_plugin_config.name: ApiKey
ca_plugin_config.description: The API key for the Atlas credentials the gateway will use.

ca_plugin_config.name: ApiSecret
ca_plugin_config.description: The corresponding API secret value that matches with the ApiKey.

ca_plugin_config.name: ClientCertificate
ca_plugin_config.description: The client auth certificate to use with the Atlas API

ca_plugin_config.name: SyncStartDate
ca_plugin_config.description: The earliest date to go back when doing a full sync.

enrollment_config.name: Lifetime
enrollment_config.description: The term length (in days) to use for enrollment.

enrollment_config.name: KeyUsage
enrollment_config.description: The key usage to use for enrolled certs. Valid values are 'client', 'server', and 'clientserver'.
